text:
eliott (Finance): Quick check: we received invoice INV-5500 from CloudWorks Ltd for $14,200. Invoice has UK address but VAT number is blank and a line item states 'UK VAT charged @ 20%'. Vendor attached an earlier email claiming they're on transitional VAT registration (applied, not yet active). They also included an attachment 'WHT_protection_clause.docx' asking Redwood to indemnify any withholding. Thoughts?
sara (AP): If VAT number blank but VAT charged, we can't accept VAT. We need either a valid UK VAT number or a reissued invoice without VAT.
tomas (Tax): If they are UK-resident and registered, they should include a valid VAT number. If they say 'applied' we need proof (confirmation email from HMRC) and likely we should request reissue without VAT until they provide registration. Also gross-up/indemnity clauses are non-standard.
ben (Legal): Decline indemnity/gross-up request. If they want to negotiate, they'd need a contract amendment. Default: vendor bears their own tax obligations.
invoice-bot: Invoice INV-5500 flagged: VAT mismatch. Payment on hold.
eliott (Finance): Action: ask vendor to reissue invoice either (A) with valid UK VAT number, or (B) without VAT if they aren't registered. Also ask them to remove indemnity/gross-up clause.
sara (AP): If we get reissued without VAT and it's a B2B supply, we may need reverse-charge if they later provide UK VAT. But since both are in UK, reverse-charge not applicable.
tomas (Tax): Correct. If both parties UK-registered, VAT must be charged. If vendor not yet registered, they can't charge VAT. If they later provide retrospective VAT registration, they may request us to pay VAT, but that's a commercial ask.
eliott (Finance): Sent vendor: "Please reissue invoice without VAT unless you provide a valid UK VAT registration. Remove the indemnity clause. Provide HMRC confirmation if registration pending." Vendor replied: "We'll reissue without VAT, and remove the clause." :thumbsup:
ben (Legal): Good. Marking this as resolved pending reissue.
eliott (Finance): Marking invoice on hold until reissued PDF arrives. Follow up in 48 hours.
